record.question: Pharmacy computer systems used in community pharmacies for maintaining patient and dispensing information are referred to as:
record.explanation: Official final key: D — Medication record system. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 10, printed Q76. Source limitation: The question describes a general software system but no answer is the standard unique name. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
